name: @folkshops/analytics-api
description: Analytics/search service (docs/decisions/0009) — Kafka consumers (CDC + business events, never mixed), Elasticsearch indexing, a tenant-scoped Analytics Query API, and a realtime SSE bridge. A separate deployable from core-api; never touches Postgres directly (Debezium's own initial snapshot bootstraps Elasticsearch, see search/alias-manager.service.ts). Named @folkshops/analytics-api, not @folkshops/analytics, to avoid colliding with the pre-existing packages/analytics — a distinct, still-unscaffolded Phase 4 shared package for product/marketing event-tracking client code, unrelated to this service's merchant business-analytics pipeline.
